Professional Storm Damage Repair Services in St. Louis, Missouri

Your home deserves immediate attention after severe weather strikes. Whether you're dealing with hail damage, wind-torn shingles, fallen debris, or water intrusion from a compromised roof, the speed and quality of those repairs determines everything. How quickly you prevent further damage. How well your home stays protected. How much you spend on secondary repairs. How your insurance claim gets handled. When storms damage your roof, you face dozens of urgent decisions that seem overwhelming. Which repairs address the immediate threat versus cosmetic issues? How do you document damage properly for insurance? What temporary measures prevent further water intrusion? Should you replace damaged sections or the entire roof? Do you need structural inspection beyond surface damage? These aren't just technical details. St. Louis weather demands more from your roof than most people realize. Spring thunderstorms bring damaging hail that tests every shingle's impact resistance. Summer storms deliver straight-line winds that challenge every nail's holding power. Fall brings heavy debris from mature trees throughout the metro area. Winter ice storms create weight loads that stress damaged structures even further. Your storm damage repair needs to address all of this, restoring full protection without compromise.

Picture this common scenario. A storm damaged your roof three months ago. You called a company that seemed responsive at first. They tarped the obvious damage and promised to return for permanent repairs. But weeks turned into months. Now you're noticing problems. Water stains spreading across your ceiling. Musty smells in your attic from trapped moisture. Mold growth starting behind walls where water found its way inside. Your temporary fix became a permanent headache, and the company that promised repairs stopped returning your calls weeks ago.

By the time you realize something's wrong, your claim deadline may have passed and your coverage gets denied because "failure to mitigate damage" voids protection. How much does hail damage roof repair cost in St. Louis?

How do I know if my roof has hail damage?

Common signs include dented or cracked shingles, granules accumulating in gutters, exposed or bruised spots on shingles, damaged flashing around vents and chimneys, and dents on metal components like vents or gutters. However, significant hail damage often isn't visible from the ground. We recommend a professional inspection after any major hailstorm. Check your gutters for granule buildup as an early warning sign.

We work directly with insurance adjusters to ensure nothing gets overlooked. Our team has extensive experience navigating St. Louis-area insurance processes and can guide you through every step.
How long do I have to file a hail damage claim?
